notes: CDER 503B outsourcing-facility letter for a sterile compounding site (Fresenius Kabi Compounding dba Fagron Sterile Services, Canton, MA): insanitary conditions/inadequate airflow controls for reconstituting sterile vancomycin vials, QU oversight failures, and building-repair deficiencies tied to IV bag defects. Firm initiated a voluntary recall of drug products due to lack of sterility assurance, so recall_concern is true. No FEI is stated in the letter body.
